update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.0 - Changelog
New --- - Add a `Dailies` run mode that clears Team Trials, Daily Races, the Daily Legend Race, the Club item request and donations, Missions and Presents, then stops. A `Career` / `Dailies` switch on the Home card picks the mode, and the new `Dailies Settings` page holds its options. - Add `Career Setup`, which starts a new career from Home using the trainee, legacy parents, support deck and friend card chosen in the new `Career Setup` settings page. Dailies can start a career when they finish, and "Start the Next Career When Done" keeps going until TP runs out. - Add in-app updates. Tapping `Update` in the `Update Available` dialog downloads the right APK, installs it and reopens the app on the new version. - Add automatic game data updates. A daily check publishes new Global trainees and support cards, the app offers to download them on launch, and a new cloud button in the drawer checks on demand. - Add a redesigned overlay with an orb and tray that has Pause, Resume and Stop, plus an overlay style picker under Misc settings. Pause now works on any screen. - Add a redesigned Home card that shows live run stats during a run and the result, crash details and log afterwards. Start now turns on the overlay and opens the game in one tap. - Add numbered debug images. Each run saves its debug images as numbered JPEGs and zips them with the log into one bundle, and a new `Debug Image Quality` slider sets the JPEG quality. - Add a `Storage Folder` row to Settings, and a warning on Home when logs are going to the hidden app folder. - Add an `Avoid Maxing Happy Meek` setting for `URA Finale` and an `Avoid Elite Team` setting for `Unity Cup`, both off by default and aimed at parent farming. - Add `Start Career Setup Test` and `Start Legacy Spark Reader Test` debug tests. - Add trainee outfit and support card catalogs to the game data and the in-app data update.
Adjustments --- - Update game data up to `Narita Brian (BLAZE) 2026-10-14`. - Reuse one screenshot per bot tick, which cut screenshots by about a third and sped up turns by about 5% in a test. - Make Grand Live open the Lessons screen when its button shows the "!" badge, skip rereading Lessons cards that cannot change the purchase, and reuse unchanged Main screen readings. A visit takes much less time. - Log game loading once when it starts and once when it ends instead of on every check, and stop saving debug images for the loading checks. - Performance improvement to the floating overlay button so it lags less when dragged.
Fixes --- - Fix the first-run wizard deleting old logs and recordings when "Move them" was tapped before a real folder was picked. - Fix a Grand Live stall where the bot bought a Lessons card, tapped a card that had changed and got stuck on an unaffordable purchase dialog. - Fix the Happy Meek duel bias never applying and the bot stalling on the Unity Cup Elite Team race. - Fix six white/gold skill pairs being linked backwards, which stopped the gold skill from being bought. - Fix the run stopping on the career end screen when the final fan count read as a huge number. - Fix the Trackblazer shop check being cleared when the shop dialog tap did not open the shop.
